  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  October 26, 2020

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the 1st Floor, Finance Conference Room at
11:30 a.m.:

  Members Present:  Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Derald Brenneman, City Attorney’s Office
  Yvonne Horton, City Clerk’s Office (Call-In)

  Staff Present:  Gilbert Gonzalez, Parks and Recreation Community Services
  Jose Cortes, Human Resources

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

1. The minutes of October 19, 2020, meeting was approved as recorded.

2. Express Medical Clinic, Inc. – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for health
  services provided in the amount of $267.00. Motion carried unanimously.

3. WInzer – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for supplies for the Graffiti Abatement
  Division in the amount of $865.00. Motion carried unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Maria Heaney reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned
at 11:37 a.m. Adjournment
